plain: Too ready to sue or go to court

webster.text: Inclined to judicial contest; given to the practice of contending in law; quarrelsome; contentious; applied to persons.

example.quote: Suppose I have your bond for a thousand pounds: if I have any wish to harass you, or if I be of a litigious disposition, I have only to assign it to a gentleman in Maryland.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
